name: Best IPTV USA 2026: Service Provider Benchmark Dataset
description: Abstract. This dataset documents a 90-day independent benchmark of 14 IPTV service providers operating in the United States market during Q3-Q4 2026. The study measured stream stability during live sports events, channel availability across US broadcast and cable networks (NFL, NBA, MLB, UFC), device compatibility across six major streaming platforms, refund-UX processing times, and price-to-feature ratios for the best IPTV USA 2026 market. Research question. Which IPTV service provider delivers the most consistent live-event performance for United States cord-cutters at the lowest total cost of ownership in 2026? Methodology. Residential IP testing was conducted across four United States cities: Columbus (Ohio) on AT&T Fiber 1 Gbps, Austin (Texas) on Spectrum Internet Ultra, Orlando (Florida) on Xfinity Gigabit, and San Jose (California) on Comcast Gigabit. Each provider was evaluated across 13 consecutive weeks on six streaming devices: Fire TV Stick 4K Max, Apple TV 4K, Chromecast with Google TV, Samsung Tizen Smart TV, NVIDIA Shield Pro, and Roku Ultra. Live-event stress windows included NFL Sunday afternoon simulcasts (CBS/FOX), NBA regional feeds, MLB blackout-safe streams, UFC pay-per-view main cards (3 events during the study window), and WWE Premium Live Events. Service providers evaluated.
